messages:
Maria: sharing new suppression preview mockup — can the a11y crew do a quick pass? https://figma.com/file/xyz :eyes: Kevin: thanks! main asks: keyboard nav, screenreader labels, and a copy pass for the small status text. Jess: quick note — I hit a focus trap on the channel chips when tabbing out of the rules list. reproduces in Chrome + VoiceOver. Oliver: likely from the chips being rendered inside a focusable container with `tabindex=0`. we can switch to `role=button` on each chip and manage focus manually. Anya: I can run an a11y checklist. high-level: focus order, focus visible style, aria-labels for toggles, aria-live for preview state, and color contrast for chips/buttons. Maria: copied. also the preview toggle label feels vague: currently 'Preview suppression' — maybe 'Preview suppressed notifications' or 'Show suppression preview'? Kevin: agree. 'Show suppression preview' reads as an action. 'Suppressed notifications preview' reads as a state. prefer action label to match the toggle behaviour. Anya: accessibility specifics I ran quickly: - Contrast: primary chip text 3.9:1 (fails AA). need >=4.5 for normal text or use larger text, or add an outline. - Focus outline: currently 2px gray on white — low visibility when chip bg is light gray. make it 3px or use distinct color token. - Screenreader: when toggle flips on we should announce 'Suppression preview enabled. X channels will be muted.' via `aria-live="polite"`. - Keyboard: chips should be reachable via Tab and actionable with Space/Enter. if they're not interactive, mark `aria-hidden=true` or use `role=presentation`. Jess: fyi the DOM currently nests chips inside a `div[tabindex=0]` that we used for a11y-friendly group focus. that causes the trap. switching to a `ul` with `li` and each chip as button should fix it. Oliver: yeah `ul > li > button.chip` is straightforward. also add `aria-pressed` for toggleable chips. Kevin: copy tweak: in the preview panel header currently 'Suppression preview (3 channels)' — suggest 'Preview: Suppressed channels (3)' or 'Preview: 3 channels will be suppressed' — which is clearer about effect. Maria: I like 'Preview: 3 channels will be suppressed' — feels actionable and clear. Anya: copy + SR note: include an offscreen `span.sr-only` with full sentence for SR users: 'Preview ON — messages from X channels will be muted until the suppression ends.' so it's explicit. Jess: adding a tiny code snippet for the aria-live region we discussed: ````html
Preview enabled: 3 channels muted
```` Oliver: also recommend `role=region` + `aria-labelledby` on the preview panel so SR users can jump to it. Anya: contrast fix proposal: use token `bg-muted-600` + white text = 5.2:1. or keep current bg and increase text weight/size. whichever matches design system. Kevin: does the preview include the inline channel badges in notification mock? if so, those badges need tooltip text for truncated names. Maria: yes, badges appear in mock. add title attribute and `aria-label` for full channel/org name. Jess: small perf/accessibility nit — when preview toggles we render a lot of faux-notifications. lazy-render only the visible ones + `aria-hidden` the offscreen ones. reduces SR noise. Anya: good call. also ensure the preview toggle can be toggled with keyboard from within any nested element — add explicit `onKeyDown` handler for Space/Enter. Kevin: timeline: can we get patch ready for review by EOW? design + a11y fixes + copy. Maria: I'll update figma and copy now. Jess/Oliver can you check implementation plan? Oliver: can do. I'll open a PR targeting `feature/preview-a11y` and link it here. design-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/412 — build started. Jess: saw the PR, leaving comments about removing the focus trap and aria-live. small suggestion on CSS for focus ring included. Anya: I'll run quick VoiceOver pass once the PR lands. please ping me in thread when it's ready. Maria: thank you everyone! assigning follow-ups: @Jess fix DOM + focus, @Oliver add `role=region` + aria labels, @Kevin finalize copy. ping me with PR link when ready. :heart: Kevin: will do. Jess: on it. Anya: will test once PR is up. Maria: closing the initial review — will post updated mock and a11y checklist later.
